name: bigquery_agent
description: Records invoices into the pool_data.invoices BigQuery table and answers questions about invoice data by running SQL queries.

skills.name: Record Invoice
skills.description: Insert a new invoice (vendor_name, invoice_id, invoice_date, invoice_total, payment_status) into the pool_data.invoices table, stamping date_processed with today's date.

skills.name: Analyze Invoices
skills.description: Run SQL queries against the pool_data.invoices table to answer questions such as totals by month, unpaid invoices, and counts.
